sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a "cohesive yet layered industrial cluster" of boatyard buildings on Bristol's harbourside is among the architecture projects from Cardiff University. Also featured is the concept of a neurodivergent-informed kitchen-garden school and a proposal for a women's housing scheme geared towards single mothers and older women. Cardiff University Institution: Cardiff University School: Welsh The post Reimagining of historic Bristol boatyard among Cardiff University projects appeared first on Dezeen .
